meta_description: Will Shone Plumbing & Handyman Service in Newcastle. Emergency plumbing repairs, installations, and general handyman work. Same-day callouts available.
hero_eyebrow: Emergency Plumbing & Handyman — Fast Local Response
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Newcastle? We arrive fast, diagnose on the spot, and get you sorted same day.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Handyman Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full installations and general maintenance — one reliable tradesman for all your home needs.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaking radiators, and blocked drains fixed fast. Most emergency callouts completed same day, with parts carried on the van for immediate repair.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New boiler installation, servicing, and emergency repairs. All work backed by warranty, and you'll understand exactly what's wrong before any repair starts.

services.title: Tap & Valve Replacement
services.desc: Leaking taps and faulty isolation valves replaced quickly. We source quality replacements and fit them to stop water waste and save you money on bills.

services.title: General Handyman Work
services.desc: Small repairs around the home — loose shelves, leaky gutters, minor carpentry, and general maintenance. Get multiple jobs done in one visit, saving you time and hassle.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: New sink, toilet, and shower installation. We handle all pipework and connections so everything works reliably from day one.

services.title: Heating System Maintenance
services.desc: Annual boiler checks, system flushing, and preventative maintenance to keep your heating running efficiently and avoid costly breakdowns in winter.

about_pullquote: I started this because I wanted to be the tradesman I'd trust with my own home.
about_para_1: Will Shone Plumbing & Handyman Service has been serving Newcastle homeowners for 15 years. What started as a one-man operation has grown through word-of-mouth recommendation, built on turning up on time, doing the job right the first time, and charging fair prices. Every job — whether an emergency at midnight or a planned boiler service — gets the same attention to detail.
about_para_2: Customers come back because they know Will will be honest about what needs fixing and won't try to sell them work they don't need. The combination of plumbing expertise and general handyman skills means you can often fix multiple issues in one visit, saving you time and repeated callout fees. That's why repeat customers and local referrals make up the backbone of the business.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Will Shone

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a burst pipe under the kitchen at 11pm on a Sunday. Will came out within the hour, found the problem, and had it repaired and tested by midnight. No fuss, no drama, just got it done. Fair price too. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: James K.

reviews.text: Needed a new boiler and a dodgy tap fixed. Will explained everything clearly, installed the boiler professionally, and sorted the tap while he was here. One visit, two jobs done. Saved me a fortune on callout fees. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Called Will on a Friday morning with a leaking radiator. He was here by lunchtime, diagnosed it as a stuck valve, and had it replaced in about 30 minutes. Professional bloke, honest advice, and very reasonable rates. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Paul M.
